idea-plugin.name: Property Key Support
idea-plugin.description:
Bean Validation and Jakarta Validation annotations often reference message keys in braces, such as {name.required}, instead of plain property names. IntelliJ does not treat these as links to messages.properties by default.

Property Key Support adds IDE support for that pattern so property keys stay easy to navigate and maintain.

Features

  • Go to declaration — Ctrl+Click a braced key in a Java message attribute to open the matching entry in messages.properties
  • Find usages — from a property key in messages.properties, jump to every annotation that references it
  • Code completion — suggests available keys while editing message values and inserts them in braced form
  • Unresolved key highlighting — references are resolved through the standard IntelliJ reference mechanism, with a gutter icon and quick fix to create missing entries
  • Rename refactoring — renaming a key in Java or in a property file updates linked usages

Supported usage

Works with string literals on the message attribute of Java validation annotations, for example:

@NotNull(message = "{user.email.required}")
@Size(min = 1, message = "{user.name.required}")

Keys are resolved against message property files in the project, including messages.properties, ValidationMessages.properties, and locale variants such as messages_en.properties.

Compatibility

  • IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition and Ultimate Edition
  • Java projects with the bundled Properties plugin

1.1.0

  • Richer code completion with message text preview and source file name
  • Support for ValidationMessages.properties and messages_*.properties locale files
  • Rename refactoring between Java keys and property files
  • Quick fix to create missing keys in messages.properties
  • Gutter icon for unresolved property keys

  • Navigation and Find Usages between braced property keys and messages.properties
  • Autocompletion for message attributes in Java annotations
  • Unresolved key highlighting
